name: uri-grep
description: This extension allows you to trigger VS Code's 'Search in Files' feature (Ctrl+Shift+F) using a custom URI scheme. This is useful for launching searches from external scripts or tools like batch files.

urigrep.defaultQuery.description: Value for 'query' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'query' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultFilesToInclude.description: Value for 'filesToInclude' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'filesToInclude' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultFilesToExclude.description: Value for 'filesToExclude' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'filesToExclude' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultIsRegex.description: Value for 'isRegex' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'isRegex' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultIsCaseSensitive.description: Value for 'isCaseSensitive' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'isCaseSensitive' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultMatchWholeWord.description: Value for 'matchWholeWord' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'matchWholeWord' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultUseExcludeSettingsAndIgno.description: Value for 'useExcludeSettingsAndIgnoreFiles' when the URI does not specify it. When this setting is left unset, 'useExcludeSettingsAndIgnoreFiles' is not sent at all and the Search panel keeps its current value.

urigrep.defaultContextLines.description: Value for 'contextLines' (number of surrounding lines to show in search results), used when the URI specifies 'contextLines' without a valid number. Context lines are only supported by the Search Editor, so a search opens in the Search Editor instead of the Search panel whenever the URI contains 'contextLines'. This setting alone does not switch to the Search Editor.

urigrep.defaultTriggerSearch.description: Whether to execute the search immediately when the URI does not specify 'triggerSearch'. Unlike the other settings, this one always applies: without it VS Code would only fill in the Search panel without running the search.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
